title: Audit Vscode Extension Old Id Format
description: Search the VS Code extension files for any code that directly constructs, parses, or pattern-matches on the old ID format and report findings.
summary: Audited VS Code extension for old ID format references. Extension is a passive consumer of CLI-generated IDs. Found old-format test data at extension.test.ts lines 839,848,920-927. No ID construction/parsing in the extension itself. All changes needed are in Go CLI GetID() methods.
